pages.title: [DEMO] Programme overview
pages.body:
[DEMO] Fictional Linden & Rowe migration. Not a Charles Tyrwhitt project or statement. Dataset: demo-spa-migration. Fixture version: 1.

Linden & Rowe is a fictional apparel retailer migrating a legacy Salesforce Commerce Cloud storefront into an SPA. Phase one covers the existing shopping journeys. The linen-polo category is the first functional discovery slice. Charles Tyrwhitt is a public reference, not the client.

Reference: https://www.charlestyrwhitt.com/us/shirts-polo-shirts/linen-polo-shirts/

All stakeholder names, project dates, requirements, bugs and architecture statements in this corpus are invented demo data. No workflow approval has been granted.

pages.title: [DEMO] Baseline requirements register
pages.body:
[DEMO] Fictional Linden & Rowe migration. Not a Charles Tyrwhitt project or statement. Dataset: demo-spa-migration. Fixture version: 1.

| RQ | WBS | Owner | Requirement | Acceptance | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| RQ-SPA-001 | 1.1 | Category browsing | Show the linen-polo category title and a home-to-polos breadcrumb; each ancestor opens its category. | A direct category URL and navigation from Polos show the same heading and breadcrumb. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-002 | 1.2 | Category browsing | Show image, product name, colour and current price on every available product card; show a previous price only when a genuine promotion applies. | Selecting a card opens the matching product and colour; unavailable price data never renders as zero. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-003 | 1.3 | Category browsing | Support size and colour filters plus price ascending, price descending and recommended sorting; show selected filters and a clear-all control. | Combining filters narrows results; sorting preserves selected filters; clearing resets filters without leaving the category. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-004 | 1.4 | Category browsing | Persist filter and sort selections in the URL and restore them on refresh and browser back/forward. | A shared category URL restores the same selections; unknown values are ignored with the remaining valid selections retained. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-005 | 1.5 | Category browsing | Show a loading state during catalog requests, a helpful empty state when no products match, and a retry action when catalog loading fails. | A failed request never appears as a successful zero-results response; retry retains the current selections. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-006 | 2.1 | Product detail | Require a valid size and colour before adding the item to the bag. | Changing colour updates the product image and availability; unavailable variants cannot be added. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-007 | 2.2 | Product detail | Render fabric composition, care guidance and a size guide from commerce content. | Missing optional care content does not hide the purchasable product. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-008 | 2.3 | Product detail | Show available, low-stock or unavailable messaging using the commerce availability response. | A stale availability response is rechecked when adding to the bag. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-009 | 2.4 | Product detail | Provide keyboard-operable product imagery and meaningful alternative text. | The selected image can be changed without a pointer and focus remains visible. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-010 | 2.5 | Product detail | Show recommendations as a separately loaded optional section. | Recommendation failures do not block product detail or add-to-bag. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-011 | 3.1 | Search | Allow a shopper to submit a textual catalog query from global navigation. | Whitespace-only input is rejected; a valid query opens a shareable results URL. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-012 | 3.2 | Search | Support size and colour filters on search results. | Selected filters are visible and can be removed independently. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-013 | 3.3 | Search | Show the original query and a clear path to browse categories when search returns no matches. | The empty screen preserves the query and offers a new search. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-014 | 3.4 | Search | Distinguish search service errors from no matches. | Retry keeps the query and filters. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-015 | 3.5 | Search | Defer type-ahead suggestions to phase two. | Phase-one search works without suggestions and does not call a suggestions service. | deferred |
| RQ-SPA-016 | 4.1 | Cart | Add the chosen variant and quantity to the active shopper bag. | A confirmed add displays the correct variant; a failed add does not increment the bag count. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-017 | 4.2 | Cart | Support valid quantity changes and remove-item actions. | Server-rejected quantities restore the previous accepted quantity and show a useful message. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-018 | 4.3 | Cart | Display subtotal, discounts and estimated total from the commerce basket response. | The UI never computes a conflicting promotional total independently. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-019 | 4.4 | Cart | Restore the guest basket after refresh within the agreed basket lifetime. | An expired basket produces an empty-bag explanation rather than a server error. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-020 | 4.5 | Cart | Explain items that become unavailable before checkout. | An unavailable line is clearly identified and cannot proceed unchanged. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-021 | 5.1 | Checkout | Allow checkout without account creation. | A guest can provide contact and delivery details without a forced sign-in. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-022 | 5.2 | Checkout | Present available delivery methods and quoted charges. | Changing address refreshes eligible methods and totals before payment. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-023 | 5.3 | Checkout | Consume the separately owned payment integration and handle its success, cancellation and failure results. | Cancelled payment returns to checkout without presenting a successful order. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-024 | 5.4 | Checkout | Show the server-confirmed order reference and summary after successful placement. | Refreshing confirmation does not place a second order. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-025 | 6.1 | Accounts | Consume the existing identity service for sign-in and sign-out. | An expired session returns the shopper to sign-in without leaking cached account details. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-026 | 6.2 | Accounts | Display the signed-in customer order list and details. | Unauthenticated requests cannot view another customer order. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-027 | 6.3 | Accounts | Support creating, editing and selecting account delivery addresses. | A rejected address change retains the previous saved address. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-028 | 6.4 | Accounts | Offer the existing identity service password-recovery journey. | The response does not reveal whether an email address exists. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-029 | 7.1 | Content and experience | Render centrally managed category navigation across storefront routes. | The current category remains navigable when optional campaign content fails. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-030 | 7.2 | Content and experience | Consume approved campaign content slots without hard-coding dated promotions. | Expired campaigns disappear according to the content schedule. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-031 | 7.3 | Content and experience | Make the phase-one journeys keyboard usable with labelled controls and announced errors. | Focus order remains logical and dynamic catalog errors are announced. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-032 | 7.4 | Content and experience | Emit optional analytics only after the relevant consent choice. | Declining analytics leaves shopping functionality usable. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-033 | 8.1 | Migration readiness | Maintain a reviewed mapping from legacy category and product URLs to SPA routes. | Every approved mapping resolves without a redirect loop. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-034 | 8.2 | Migration readiness | Compare representative migrated product and variant counts against SFCC. | Missing variants and price discrepancies are reported before release. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-035 | 8.3 | Migration readiness | Maintain an operator-reviewed rollback plan for the storefront cutover. | A rehearsal records the restored legacy route and ownership of unresolved incidents. | phase-one baseline |
| RQ-SPA-036 | 8.4 | Migration readiness | Record failed commerce calls and route errors with trace identifiers. | Operators can correlate a failed shopper request without logging payment secrets. | phase-one baseline |
